premiumResponse.semantics: Measured exact endpoints. Spot intrinsic is an arithmetic proxy; the remainder is not isolated Theta or IV.

Snapshot describes recorded endpoints; no crossing or causality claim.

Descriptive comparison only; no candidate, probability, causality or profitability claim.

IV, liquidity, event regime, OI, PCR and wall context are not matched in this stage.
Standard-session model expiry clock; contract-master and special-session validation unavailable.
No future outcomes retrieved; supplied days and recorded contracts are not exhaustive.
